# Forcing Perks in Non-Supported Modes

Source: [wiki article 7418](../archive/7418.md); edited 2025-10-14.

<a id="wiki-7418-n1"></a>

- Documented workaround manually adds Enable Perks: On under settings > modes > General when a mode lacks a functional Enable Perks setting.

<a id="wiki-7418-n2"></a>

- Enabling the setting does not guarantee working progression. Table documents Stadium partial support with progress lost across rounds, Overwatch: Classic no progression, and full support for Mirrorwatch, Junkenstein's Revenge, Winston's Beach Volleyball and Lucioball.

<a id="wiki-7418-n3"></a>

- Volleyball/Lucioball cannot normally earn perk progress because their gameplay prevents damage/healing; source defines full support as progression through normal or Workshop damage/healing.
